<a id="selection-through-a-map-of-the-alternatives--经备择之映射的选择"></a>
# Selection through a map of the alternatives

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`selection-through-a-model-of-the-options` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F04 · [record](selection-through-a-model-of-the-options.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> For alternatives with decided equality and a map giving each an entry of any kind: two are selected alike by every selection through the map exactly when the map ties them, and such a selection selecting at most one alternative can select k exactly when no other alternative's entry equals k's.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Exchanging two alternatives (swap) is an involution. A selection, a valuation and a choice are through the map when exchanging two alternatives' entries exchanges what is selected, the values or the choice. Exchanging two tied alternatives leaves the map as it was. (`Becoming.Relabel.swap`, `Becoming.Relabel.swap_left`, `Becoming.Relabel.swap_right`, `Becoming.Relabel.swap_other`, `Becoming.Relabel.swap_swap`, `Becoming.Relabel.swap_inj`, `Becoming.Relabel.Equivariant`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantValue`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantChoice`, `Becoming.Relabel.fixed_of_tied`)
2. Tied alternatives are selected alike, and two alternatives are selected alike by every selection through the map exactly when the map ties them. The witness selects the alternatives whose entry equals a given value. (`Becoming.Relabel.Equivariant.tied`, `Becoming.Relabel.selected_alike_iff`)
3. A selection through the map that selects at most one alternative selects no tied alternative, and none at a full tie of two or more. Holding an entry alone (Alone) is such a selection, so an alternative can be singled out exactly when no other alternative's entry ties it. (`Becoming.Relabel.Equivariant.untied`, `Becoming.Relabel.Equivariant.none_of_full_tie`, `Becoming.Relabel.Alone`, `Becoming.Relabel.alone_equivariant`, `Becoming.Relabel.alone_single`, `Becoming.Relabel.singled_iff_untied`)
4. A valuation through the map, such as a weight on each alternative, gives tied alternatives equal values, and every alternative the same at a full tie; the alternatives taking a value form a selection through the map; a constant valuation is one; two alternatives are valued alike by every such valuation exactly when tied. (`Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantValue.tied`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantValue.full_tie`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantValue.level`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantValue.const`, `Becoming.Relabel.entry_equivariant`, `Becoming.Relabel.valued_alike_iff`)
5. A choice of at most one alternative through the map selects, through the map, the alternative it chooses; it chooses no tied alternative and withholds at a full tie. (`Becoming.Relabel.map_swap_eq_some`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantChoice.selects`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantChoice.single`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantChoice.untied`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantChoice.withholds_of_full_tie`)
6. The map is a lumping (Learning.Lumped): a selection through it is a selection through its lumping, right about what matters (a predicate p or values f) only where what matters goes alike across the lumping; where what matters separates two alternatives the map lumps, none is right; where it is read off the map, reading it through the map is right. (`Becoming.Learning.selects_through_lumping`, `Becoming.Learning.values_lumped`, `Becoming.Learning.selects_right_through`, `Becoming.Learning.selects_not_right_of_parted`, `Becoming.Learning.selects_right_of_reads`, `Becoming.Learning.values_right_lumped`, `Becoming.Learning.values_not_right_of_parted`, `Becoming.Learning.values_right_of_reads`)
7. Instance (periphery, own checker, which also compiles and audits the originals): PluralRecords' records are maps of the alternatives Fin n, a rule treating the centers alike is a choice through the map, and a lottery treating them alike in TieBreaking has weights through it; seven theorems follow from the core, PluralRecords.pick finding the holder, every axiom report empty. (`Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.transpose_eq_swap`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.treatsAlike_iff`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.lotteryAlike_iff`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.alone_iff`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.tied_not_served_by_core`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.first_lt`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.all_tied_forces_withholding_by_core`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.servable_iff_untied_by_core`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.tied_equal_weight_by_core`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.full_tie_equal_weights_by_core`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.uniform_alike_by_core`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.pointMass_one`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.point_mass_not_alike_at_tie_by_core`)
8. Along a run: with the moments of a run as the alternatives and the run's course through a map as the selector's map, every selection, valuation and choice through the course treats alike the moments at which the map takes one value and separates exactly what the map separates; where the course takes one value throughout nothing is singled out; a selection or valuation through the course is right about a feature exactly where the feature goes alike across the map's lumping, and not where the course lumps moments the feature tells apart. (`Becoming.Relabel.selected_alike_iff`, `Becoming.Relabel.valued_alike_iff`, `Becoming.Relabel.singled_iff_untied`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantChoice.untied`, `Becoming.SelectionRuns.choice_withholds_of_constant`, `Becoming.SelectionRuns.values_alike_of_constant`, `Becoming.SelectionRuns.value_level_alike`, `Becoming.SelectionRuns.selects_through_coupling`, `Becoming.SelectionRuns.values_lumped`, `Becoming.Learning.selects_not_right_of_parted`, `Becoming.SelectionRuns.selects_right_of_reads`, `Becoming.Learning.values_not_right_of_parted`, `Becoming.SelectionRuns.values_right_of_reads`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. The alternatives' equality is decided (exchanging two alternatives needs it); entries are of any kind; that a selection, valuation or choice is through the map is a hypothesis, and what matters (p, f) is given.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That an alternative singled out is found by a choice function: that needs a search over listed alternatives, the periphery's PluralRecords.pick.
- Whether an equal chance legitimately breaks a tie, or priority by size or by turn: these keep the originals' scope.
- A form without the alternatives' equality decided: exchanging two alternatives needs it.
- Which map is right, or what matters: p and f are given; where a finer map comes from belongs to learning.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren, 16 October 2026, chose “Closest gaps first” on the I4 classification table; PluralRecords and TieBreaking were read as join candidates, and the names follow Ren's rule of the same day for joined modules. The result was first titled “Selection by the record alone”. Ren corrected it the same day: “it is about the cognitive model, not just record, which feels as long as we remember all pasts we can move forward without wisdom”, and approved the reframing. Reading (the AI's reading of Ren's correction, approved by Ren): what a model lumps, no selection through it can separate; separating them takes a finer model, and whether that model is right is its fit to what matters, which remembering more does not supply. Equivariance under exchanging options is the neutrality condition of May (1952), and the tie is the Buridan symmetry. The earlier reading, that a further recorded relation such as an order of arrival parts a tie, is withdrawn.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- none
- related, not a proved adapter: [selection-through-couplings](selection-through-couplings.md). A law of the same form: selection through the couplings selects alike exactly what is alike through them (Web.selects_alike_iff), and selection through a map separates exactly what the map separates.
- related, not a proved adapter: [generalization-through-lumping](generalization-through-lumping.md). The map is a lumping: a selection through it is right only where what matters goes alike across the lumping, the form of lumped_right_iff.
